Name: Demetrius (3 John)
Summary: Demetrius was a believer commended in 3 John as having a good report from all men and from the truth itself. He is treated here as distinct from Demetrius the silversmith, since the letter gives no link between them.
KeyStory: Demetrius was a believer commended in 3 John as having a good report from all men and from the truth itself. He is treated here as distinct from Demetrius the silversmith, since the letter gives no link between them.
LifeLesson: A good report from all and from the truth is the best recommendation a believer can carry.
